-- 2022 projects

-- Mamma Mia!
INSERT INTO projectTags (projectId, tagId)
SELECT p.id, t.id FROM projects p CROSS JOIN tags t
WHERE p.title = 'Mamma Mia!' AND t.name IN ('Musical Theatre', '2022', 'ABBA', 'Jukebox Musical', 'Summer Stock', 'Greek Island')
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE projectId = projectId;

-- Newsies
INSERT INTO projectTags (projectId, tagId)
SELECT p.id, t.id FROM projects p CROSS JOIN tags t
WHERE p.title = 'Newsies' AND t.name IN ('Musical Theatre', '2022', 'Disney', 'Historical', 'New York City', 'Labor Movement')
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE projectId = projectId;

-- Legally Blonde
INSERT INTO projectTags (projectId, tagId)
SELECT p.id, t.id FROM projects p CROSS JOIN tags t
WHERE p.title = 'Legally Blonde' AND t.name IN ('Musical Theatre', '2022', 'Comedy', 'Contemporary', 'Empowerment', 'College')
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE projectId = projectId;
